title: Capture demo — a phone-first preview of the "Capture" surface, in a new repo
summary: Seed plan for the NOVATEK Capture phone-first preview: locked user decisions, real-vs-authored claims, BMAD/GSD workflow, implementation design, API contracts, offline semantics, and build order.
scope: ipv-demo sibling stack (Next.js 16.2.12, React 19.2.4, TypeScript, CSS Modules)
authored observation proposals and accept/reject gate
referrals and Flag records (/api/referrals, bounded existence disclosure)
offline queue, batch sync and server-side reconciliation (/api/sync, applyItem)
service worker and PWA shell precache
camera and voice capture (getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, IndexedDB)
governed copy sentences and claims audit
synthetic plant fixtures (artisans, work orders, observations, register)
BMAD 6.11.0 and GSD 1.42.3 workflow and ingest manifest
production infrastructure suggestions (Cloud Run africa-south1, Entra ID, EgoBlur)
notes: Type taken from manifest (DOC, precedence 5). Content signals would otherwise compete: the doc carries a 'Decisions taken with the user (do not relitigate)' table and a design-decisions table (ADR-like), API contract and data-model tables (SPEC-like), and a build-order roadmap; the manifest and the doc itself state the PRD, UX spec and architecture.md are the fuller, authoritative statements. Filename hash suffix is a 00000000 placeholder: no execution tool was available to compute SHA-256 of the source path; slug is unique within this project so no collision risk.
